thresholds.free_speed: edge speed limit (Overture speed_limits or class default)
rules: r = mean speed / free speed: >=0.8 free, 0.6-0.8 moderate, 0.4-0.6 heavy, <0.4 congested
k_lane >= 40 veh/km/lane: at least heavy; k_lane >= 70: congested
k_lane < 7 veh/km/lane: at most moderate (isolated stops at signals/junctions)
no vehicles in the interval: no state

statement.counts: Hourly targets are derived from UK DfT road traffic counts (AADF, AADF by direction and raw manual counts; Open Government Licence v3.0). Each count point is either Counted or Estimated by DfT, recorded per point as estimation_method.
statement.hourly_profiles: Share of AADF per hour from the point's recent weekday raw counts (07:00-19:00 only); points without raw counts use the pooled median profile of their road type (flagged as profile_source). No night (19:00-07:00) profile is used or invented.
statement.demand: General traffic (all motor vehicles minus buses and coaches) is calibrated to the edge targets with SUMO routeSampler from randomTrips/duarouter candidate routes; routes, origins and destinations are model choices, and traffic on roads without counts is only what passes through counted edges. Sampled vehicles whose route would exceed an assumed per-lane edge capacity (calibration.capacity_screening) are dropped before simulation; the fit before and after screening and after simulation is reported per period.
statement.state: Speeds, densities, occupancies, waiting times and LOS classes are SUMO mesoscopic (with junction control: signals and right of way delay vehicles) model output, not observations.
statement.network: OpenStreetMap road network (ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; planet ORC snapshot on AWS Open Data) imported with netconvert: lanes, turn lanes, bus lanes, speed limits, one-ways, access, signal locations and turn restrictions from OSM tags; left-hand traffic.
statement.buses: Bus demand from GTFS (separate step) where present for a period; present for: am_peak, inter_peak, pm_peak
